scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: Dual stream adaptive sequential recommendation
papers.authors: Swastika Ghosh, Sourav Mandal, Rohini Basak, Dilip K. Prasad, Arif Ahmed Sekh
papers.abstract: DSASR employs independent causal transformer encoders for short-term and long-term preference with a consistency gate.
papers.summary: 针对短期意图与长期兴趣混合的问题，DSASR 使用两个独立因果 Transformer，并依据兴趣漂移与用户属性门控融合，联合 BCE 和 BPR 训练。在 MovieLens 1M 上 HR@10 为 0.8043、NDCG@10 为 0.5832；Amazon Beauty 上 NDCG@10 为 0.2686，代码已公开。
papers.key_insight: 可借鉴的是把长短期偏好差异显式用于融合权重，让近期行为在兴趣突变时获得更高影响力。社区 UGC 搜索可将其作为用户侧特征，与当前查询相关性联合排序，并分别检查活跃用户和稀疏用户的 nDCG、CTR；上述离线结果不能直接视为线上收益。

papers.title: Auto-Bidding with Disentangled Advertiser Profiles and Train-Free Adaptation
papers.authors: Songyue Cai, Shan Gu, Wei Chen, Ziru Xu, Lianyu Wang, Jian Xu, Xiaofeng Zhu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.21308v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Auto-bidding is a key component of modern advertising systems that provides a personalized bidding strategy for each advertiser. By characterizing each individual, profile-based methods achieve personalization and have proven effective in domains such as recommendation. However, despite the diverse bidding behavior of advertisers, their application to auto-bidding remains limited. A primary reason is that constructing and leveraging advertiser profiles face several challenges: extracting pure profiles is non-trivial, modeling common and private information simultaneously is difficult, and profile updating and cold-start adaptation remain challenging. To tackle these issues, we propose \textbf{ADAPT}, an \underline{\textbf{A}}uto-bidding framework with \underline{\textbf{D}}isentangled \underline{\textbf{A}}dvertiser \underline{\textbf{P}}rofiles and \underline{\textbf{T}}raining-free adaptation. ADAPT introduces a two-stage training para
papers.summary: ADAPT 通过两阶段训练提取广告主静态与动态画像，再将动态画像分解为共享和私有部分，以支持无重训更新与冷启动。在 AuctionNet 的新广告主实验中，零样本方案相对零画像的 Score 从 106 提升至 134，转化数从 128 提升至 151；结果来自基准实验。
papers.key_insight: 这项工作与本赛道的联系在于画像分解和冷启动适配，目标任务本身是广告出价。社区 UGC 搜索可以试验共享兴趣原型与用户私有状态分离，在新用户阶段利用共享状态初始化，但必须重新验证排序收益；文中的转化指标不能换算为搜索 CTR。

papers.title: Do We Care About Personalization and Explainability? An Interview Study with News Recommendation Engineers
papers.authors: Jasmin Kareem, Siddharth Mehrotra, Martijn C. Willemsen, Maarten de Rijke
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.21547v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Research on explainability in recommender systems largely centers on end users, overlooking the perspectives of those who build and maintain these systems and their potential use cases such as model debugging. In this study, we examine how news engineers and related technical stakeholders perceive and implement personalization and explainability in practice. We conducted 15 semi-structured interviews across nine news organizations, spanning diverse regions in both public and private sectors, to investigate the challenges and motivations shaping their approaches. Our findings reveal that personalization is not always a straightforward or desirable choice for news organizations, as concerns around user tracking, editorial control, and resource constraints often limit its adoption. Even among organizations implementing personalized news recommender systems in production, explainability is rarely prioritized, with day-to-day operational de
papers.summary: 研究通过对 9 家新闻机构开展 15 次半结构化访谈，分析工程团队如何采用个性化与可解释方法。结果指出，用户追踪限制、编辑控制和资源投入会影响个性化的实际部署，日常运维通常先于解释工具建设；这是跨机构质性证据，没有报告 CTR 或 nDCG 提升。
papers.key_insight: 对社区 UGC 搜索，可解释性可以先服务于内部排序排障和运营沟通：显示用户兴趣依据、内容命中原因与干预记录，再评估是否需要面向终端用户展示。实践价值来自明确工具使用者与排障任务；访谈样本支持需求分析，不能替代线上随机实验。

papers.title: Adaptive Preference Modeling via Explicit Indirect Relational Learning for Personalized Fashion Matching
papers.authors: Shuiying Liao, Li Li, P. Y. Mok
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.21475v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Personalized fashion complementary recommendation requires jointly modeling user preferences and item compatibility under sparse and multimodal data conditions. Existing approaches often capture higher-order relational signals implicitly through graph propagation or rely on direct interaction data, limiting their ability to explicitly model indirect preference and compatibility relationships. To address this limitation, we propose an Adaptive Preference with Contrastive Learning framework (APCL) that explicitly models both direct and indirect relational signals within a unified recommendation architecture. Specifically, APCL constructs indirect user-item and item-item relationships through a correlation-guided adaptive aggregation mechanism and represents them as dedicated personalization and compatibility views. To improve representation learning, we further introduce a functional view contrastive learning strategy that aligns direct an
papers.summary: APCL 针对稀疏时尚搭配推荐，显式构建直接和间接的用户偏好、物品兼容关系，并通过功能视图对比学习对齐表示。在给定上装的 IQON 实验中 AUC 为 0.9739、HR@10 为 0.9509；去掉对比学习后 AUC 为 0.9635，说明间接关系需要有效的训练约束。
papers.key_insight: 可迁移的设计是将用户偏好与内容间兼容关系分开建模，并让间接邻域提供辅助监督。用于社区 UGC 搜索时，可探索用户兴趣和帖子关联的独立特征，但服饰搭配并非查询相关性任务；应先检查长尾分组与负采样协议，再验证 nDCG 和点击率。
